why: Source: pick max-minus-min as the measure, four range subtractions (two with negatives), rank and match (about 6 steps); question: the same measure, four subtractions with two negatives, rank and match (about 6 steps).

Source: four statement checks of the same types (revenue share, revenue growth comparison, relative margin decline read off gridlines, multi-year profit sums of revenue times margin), about 8 steps; question: the same four check types reordered, with the heavy profit-sum check now a distractor, about 8 steps.

Source: annual labour and electricity cost for each model, annual saving, times the three-year threshold (about 5 steps); question: the identical structure with repair visits and kWh, saving, times three (about 5 steps).
Source: profit for each period (revenue minus costs or revenue times margin), then the difference (3 steps); question: the same two profit calculations and difference (3 steps).

Source: items per day for each period, percentage change, choose direction and size (about 4 steps); question: passengers per sailing day for each period, percentage change, direction and size (about 4 steps), with the same days-adjustment trap.

Source: gridline readings on three indexed lines plus four checks (a share comparison, the base-week indexing trap, a proportionality check, a points-difference comparison), about 7 steps; question: the same readings and the same four check types reordered, with the share check spread over more weeks but the same kind of work, about 7 to 8 steps.
Source: multiply cups by size for four countries and compare (about 5 steps); question: multiply packs by pack size for four countries and compare (about 5 steps).

Source: four statement checks (20-year extrapolation for two segments and compare, segment versus rest-of-market growth, three-times growth-rate comparison, share of total four years ago), about 9 steps; question: the same four check types reordered with the growth-rate one now true, about 9 steps.

Source: gridline readings of two indexed lines, profit as revenue times margin index, and four checks (rate ratio, two-year profit sums, half-year comparison, start-to-end profit change), about 8 steps; question: the same readings and the same four check types reordered, about 8 steps.

Source: map waterfall bars to categories, two group sums with a share each, two single-bar shares against thresholds (about 6 steps); question: the same mapping, two group sums with shares, and two single-bar threshold checks (about 6 steps).
